notes: Summary: Strong product fit for transaction/approval assistant and reranking of credit decision results, but stalled mid-POC primarily due to integration friction + corporate budget freeze.

Key technical asks we could not satisfy quickly: native SDK support for streaming in their existing Node microservice stack, helper to automatically surface per-request trace_id for Datadog, clear SAML SP metadata URL for their IdP tests.
Quote from engineering lead (2026-02-02): "We could make it work with the HTTP API but we need a SDK-level helper to keep latency predictable — otherwise too many edge-case retries."
Security asked specifically for: audit log retention policies, example KMS integration flow, and on-prem/private deployment network diagrams (for legal review).
Competitive angle: procurement team flagged that OpenAI + third-party integration partner could deliver a working prototype faster (they accepted higher per-token cost to hit roadmap deadlines).
Outcome: Deal effectively closed-lost for this quarter. Opportunity to re-engage after budget cycle (Q3) or if Redwood ships SDK + tracing helpers as requested.

Action items: capture SDK feature request (streaming helpers, typed responses), add SAML SP metadata endpoint to private deployment docs, create a tracing integration example (Datadog + OpenTelemetry) and ping Jon to include in next AE touchpoint.
